answer: To secure consensus, validators commit staking collateral to a liquidity sink where slashing penalties scale quadratically to enforce a robust Nash equilibrium. This architecture forces marginal attack costs to escalate super-linearly, rendering malicious takeovers economically unviable compared to the honest acquisition of protocol yield like harvesting a pearl from a deep voyage. Consequently, this cryptographic garden ensures that any potential extracted value remains strictly bounded below the verifiable capital expenditure required to manipulate the state machine.
